task.question: What event occurs in Benin on January 11, 2026?
task.evidence: January 11 – The 2026 Beninese parliamentary election is held.
task.sonnet_answer: January 10 is Benin's National Voodoo Day (Fête du Vodoun), a public holiday; festivities often continue on January 11. In 2026, January 11 falls the day after this national celebration of Vodoun culture in Benin.

answer:
On January 11, 2026, parliamentary elections will be held in Benin to elect all 109 members of the National Assembly. 

FINAL: Parliamentary elections in Benin.

[en:2026 Beninese parliamentary election] Parliamentary elections were held in Benin on 11 January 2026 to elect all 109 members of the National Assembly. The preliminary results of the election were announced on 17 January. The result was a victory for parties supportive of President Patrice Talon, Progressive Union Renewal and Republican Bloc, which together won all 109 seats in the National Assembly. | Other titles: ['List of elections in 2026', '2026 national electoral calendar']
